g.title: Motor control, PWM output and end switches.
provides async ctrl : MotorCmd (accepts the events)
requires async status : MotorStatus (sends the events)
requires sync pwm : integer (requires the data)
provides async sensors : event endSwitch, event overcurrent (accepts the events)
provides sync speed : integer (provides the data)
PWM output of the motor bridge (hardware driver).
provides sync duty : integer (provides the data)
End switches and current monitor (hardware driver, interrupt driven).
requires async events : event endSwitch, event overcurrent (sends the events)
provides async ctrl : MotorCmd (accepts the events)
requires async status : MotorStatus (sends the events)
